slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-9″ or faster

note: PDR drive band spacing is .2009″ (recommend two drive bands in case neck for concentricity) Tip length is .143″. Recommended use: Small to Big Game Hunting. Form factor= .93. The product page also says: "This Hammer HBC™ is a light very sexy quarter bore designed to be fully stable in a 1-9″ twist barrel or faster. With the secant ogive and only two PDR drive bands this pure copper Hammer HBC™ runs very high velocity and very high bc for it’s weight. The Hammer HBC™ is designed to maximize ballistic coefficient for the bullet weight. Make sure the bullet specifications will work in your cartridge and rifle system. May require single feeding." The product page also says: "AT THIS TIME TIPS ARE CONSUMER INSTALLED" The product page also says: "TIPPING BLOCK INCLUDED WITH EACH ORDER"
